name: gguf-edit
desc: Free, open-source GGUF metadata editor for Windows — change chat template, system prompt and params without requanting. 100 MB MIT.
features: ✅ **Edit without requanting** — chat template, system prompt, stop tokens and context length written in place, weights untouched
✅ **Template library** — built-in Jinja and ChatML presets with a live render preview against sample messages
✅ **Header diff view** — original and modified KV pairs side by side before saving
✅ **Safe writes** — every edit creates a copy by default, with optional in-place patch mode for large files
✅ **Parameter tuning** — rope scaling, sliding window, attention flags exposed with plain-language hints
✅ **Shard awareness** — edits apply to split GGUF sets as one logical model
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, portable, offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases
compare: | Feature | **gguf-edit** | gguf-py scripts | LM Studio | KoboldCpp |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Free, OSS | Free | Free, OSS |
| GUI metadata editing | **Yes** | No | No | No |
| Template render preview | **Yes** | No | Partial | No |
| Header diff before save | **Yes** | No | No | No |
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Scripts | Installer | Zip |
faqQ: how to change the chat template in a GGUF file?
faqA: A wrong template is why a local model answers like a brick, yet fixing it normally means Python scripts that rewrite the header by hand. gguf-edit exposes the KV pairs with a live render preview and writes changes without requanting the weights. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline, and it edits a copy by default.
s1: Dark editor (#121418, violet #C084FC): KV table left with tokenizer.chat_template highlighted, template text area right, render preview panel below.
s2: Diff view: three changed keys listed with old and new values, save-copy button enabled, in-place patch toggle off with warning chip.
s3: Parameters tab: context length field at 8192, rope scaling dropdown, sliding window toggle, plain-language hint text under each control.
